lines.en: I float through the air, advancing slowly.

lines.zh: 三个头各自看着一个方向
lines.en: Each of my three heads watches a direction.
My ribs creak in the wind.
Ash rises where I pass.
I fly at you without haste.
Three heads, each watching a direction.
Every movement presses on the air.
I go around trees, not around walls.
I skim the ground for a stretch.

lines.zh: 我的两个头在低声说话
lines.en: Two of my heads murmur to each other.

lines.zh: 我悬停着，三个头都在看
lines.en: I hover, all three heads watching.
Ash falls from me.
My chest glows.
This body needs no air.

lines.zh: 我记得自己是被召唤的
lines.en: I remember being summoned.

lines.zh: 有人用灵魂沙堆出了我
lines.en: Someone built me from soul sand.
I'm stronger than the one before.

lines.zh: 我的三个头意见不太一致
lines.en: My three heads don't quite agree.

lines.zh: 三颗头各自看一个方向。
lines.en: Each of my three heads watches a different direction.
The air grows heavy around me.
I watch you from three angles.
Dark light shows between my bones.
All three heads watch your bow.
The sky here is too bright.
I lift a hand slightly.
Ash spirals around me.
All three heads turn to you at once.
You stand steady. I dislike that.

lines.zh: 我低头，把你罩在影子里
lines.en: I lower myself and put you in my shadow.
The weapon you brought is unimpressive.

lines.zh: 你身上的腐肉味我记下了。
lines.en: I have noted the rotten flesh on you.
You want to run. I know.
One of my heads is laughing.
Another is counting your bones.
Back away. I'm not ready to strike.
So small, and yet you stand straight.

lines.zh: 三颗头，比我原来的更凶。
lines.en: Three heads, fiercer than before.
Three heads, three angles on you.
My frame rings once.
One of my bones has cracked.

lines.zh: 我退了半格，重新升起来
lines.en: I fall back half a block and rise again.
Ash spills from the breach.
This body will hold.
I feel no pain, only attrition.
One of my heads is askew.
I set it straight again.
This will be mended soon.
I will remember that arrow.

lines.zh: 我不需要面包，只需要魂。
lines.en: I need no bread, only souls.
You holding that up is absurd.
I can't be bothered to look.
That's nothing to me.

lines.zh: 我要的是你的下界之星。
lines.en: What I want is your nether star.
Put that thing away.
I'll find my own.
Keep it to save your life.
This won't make me stop.
I'm thinking of other things.
You bounce off and land in the soul sand.
My body is harder than iron.
I barely felt it.
You hit a wall made of air.
I tilt aside and let you pass.
My bones scrape audibly.

lines.zh: 你被弹开的时候，我笑了
lines.en: When you bounced off, I laughed.

lines.zh: 你的剑尖只刮到我的肋骨。
lines.en: Your blade only grazed my ribs.

lines.zh: 我升起来，从你头顶过去
lines.en: I rise and pass over your head.
You'd best not try again.

lines.zh: 我不是生出来的，是拼的。
lines.en: I was not born. I was pieced together.
Such a thing has no companion.
My three heads would never agree.
If you stay, stand further off.
I need nothing.
I exist only to destroy.

lines.zh: 下界之星能把我唤出来。
lines.en: A Nether Star can call me forth.
I'll remember you. That's all.

lines.zh: 你走吧，趁我还没改主意
lines.en: Go, before I change my mind.

lines.zh: 我从不留活的东西在身边
lines.en: I never keep living things near.
I pick it up between bone fingers.
It crumbles to ash in my grip.
This isn't worth mentioning.
I drop it.
I squeeze it; it's brittle.
I'll keep it as a marker.

lines.zh: 这堆灰里，有我旧日的骨头。
lines.en: My old bones are in this heap of ash.
It's of little use to me.
I blow the ash away.
Take these yourself.

lines.zh: 我的三个头都锁定了你
lines.en: All three of my heads have locked on.
You're already within my range.
I begin gathering dark light.
You've raised your hand. Good.
I've waited long for this blow.
You're the only living thing here.
I can strike you from midair.
My ribs have opened up.
The wind begins pulling my way.

lines.zh: 我在数你的呼吸，胸口起伏。
lines.en: I'm counting your breaths, watching your chest rise.
My shadow reaches you first.
It's about to begin.
This time I won't hold back.
The light on you is very faint.

lines.zh: 我的三个头一起张开了口
lines.en: All three mouths open together.
You can't withdraw now.
Three pairs of eyes lock onto you.
Let's see how long you last.

lines.zh: 从现在起，你只有一个敌人
lines.en: From now on, you have one enemy.
And it's me.
I hover above your head and will not come down.
Wherever you go, I follow.
Each head computes its angle.
You're at the wall with nowhere back.
I begin to descend.
You're hunting cover. There is none.
My joints are rattling.
I see the hand holding your sword.
Three faces turn toward you at once.
The wind tears your voice away.
I turn my body square to you.
You have one step of room left.
That step is gone now.

lines.zh: 我的胸口亮得像烧起来
lines.en: My chest blazes bright.
Each of my heads calculates its angle.
That's bone growing.
I've no more reason to wait.
Which of my heads are you watching?
You chose the wrong one.
Now. Bow your head.
One head strikes first.
Dark light lances from between my bones.
It's thrown into the air.
The second head bites down.
The third adds the final blow.
My nails score the ground.
That one burns the soil black.
I come down and shatter the stone.
It's still struggling. I press again.
My frame is loud with the effort.
A crack has opened in my rib.
That doesn't hinder me.
I gather for the next.
Your armor didn't hold.

lines.zh: 灵魂沙堆起来，我出现了
lines.en: The soul sand rose, and I appeared.

lines.zh: 我用下界之星把自己改了
lines.en: I remade myself with a nether star.
The old body wasn't enough.
Now I'm faster, and crueler.
Ash fell first, then came I.
My three heads wake one by one.
The first head sees the sky.
The sky is too bright. I hate it.
I begin to drift upward.
Death rolls off me in waves.
Every living thing here has fled.
I remember who summoned me.
He's long gone.
But I remain.
I begin looking for a target.
My frame knits fully together.
I clench a fist. Good.
Wind rises behind me.
The soul sand splits, and I rise.
Watch.
Fire burns between my bones.

lines.zh: 我从高处砸下，骨都散了
lines.en: I crash down from a height and my bones scatter.
Water floods my chest.
The blast spins me off my heading.
A sharp thing lodges between my bones.

lines.zh: 这股法术压着我的核心
lines.en: This spell bears down on my core.
Too long without drawing in; I'm fading.
Lightning struck through all three of my heads.
The void tears my frame apart.
